tip: Fattas is deponent and takes the missing thing as its subject: han fattas mig means he is missing to me.
The -s ending plus åt makes a verb reciprocal: vi följdes åt = we went along with each other.
Umgås exists only in the -s form and means to spend time together. There is no plain umga: vi umgås = we socialize.
Use det finns for both there is and there are, whatever the number: det finns många sjöar = there are many lakes.
The -s ending can form a passive, and av marks the doer: jag berörs av musiken = I am touched by the music.
Skulle kunna plus an infinitive means could or would be able to: jag skulle kunna hjälpa = I could help.
Kommer att plus an infinitive is the plain future: det kommer att bli dyrt = it will be expensive.
For the past conditional use skulle ha plus the supine form: skulle inte ha gjort = would not have done.
When a phrase like i gengäld opens the clause, the verb still stays second and the subject follows: i gengäld hjälper jag.
Visar sig means turns out or proves to be, and the sig is required: det visar sig vara sant = it turns out to be true.
Halv fem means half to five, that is 4:30, not 5:30. Swedish counts down toward the coming hour.
